text: Triage 2026-09-17 (docs/TRACKER_TRIAGE_2026-09-17.md, commit 34f234c). The monolithic analysis-plan ADT is superseded: three concrete plan families (StudyPlan, RecordingPlan, TemporalStudyPlan) plus PreparedStudy carry inspection, diff, codecs and execution, and UI-X4 interprets PreparedStudy directly. Rescoped to a shared plan interface and the journey nodes still missing. All nine blocking edges that pointed here were dropped; the work they gated was delivered against concrete plans.
